toleranceCalibrationPlan: Use only unchanged-original comparisons: three timed repeats and two untimed 45-image replays. Predeclared headroom: image-rmse = ceil(2 * maximum observed RMSE * 10000) / 10000; image-max = maximum observed byte difference + 1. SSIM >= 0.98 separately for every native-resolution image. No tolerance is fitted to a candidate.
userQualityClarification: User: as long as it is pretty close, I am not fussed. Preserve SSIM .98, state equality and visual review; allow independently calibrated rounding controls instead of repeatability-only RMSE for reviewed numerical differences.
roundingCalibrationPlan: Before applying relaxed tolerances: quantize original native RGB to nearest even byte (ties up, clip 255), alpha unchanged; calculate native SSIM and RMSE on all 45 originals. Require every control SSIM >= .98. Pair tolerance becomes max control RMSE; max-byte remains repeatability-derived 4. Candidate data excluded.

final.units: milliseconds; native offscreen GPU duration and synchronous CPU work are separate

cpuAssessment.note: Passing the existing significance-based regression gate does not establish CPU non-inferiority when its uncertainty interval still allows a meaningful regression.

changes: Two-ray GI uses separate native-resolution primary-hit, secondary-visibility and shading stages with full-precision records. Hit tracing uses 8x4 groups, visibility 8x4x2, and shading 8x8 with the two original rays accumulated serially per pixel.
BVH traversal carries the immediate near child in scalar state, stores node IDs in its 32-entry stack and uses two-primitive leaves.
Terrain upload precomputes the original clamped four-fetch maximum at every mip, allowing one texture load per visited terrain node with the same bounds.

Secondary hit shading uses the existing distant-lighting approximation beyond 64 metres instead of 250 metres. Primary shadows, GI ray counts, advertised settings, output dimensions and simulation are unchanged.

validation.ssimEvaluatorTestNote: The evaluator is unchanged; its four previously passed checks were not rerun for every candidate.

tradeoffs: At 3840x2160 the GI intermediates add 199065600 bytes (about 199 MB or 189.8 MiB) of GPU texture storage and two additional GI dispatches.
Terrain-bound work moves to terrain upload; the GPU pyramid has the same dimensions and storage size.
The 64-metre secondary-lighting threshold is a rendering approximation and requires the original-baseline image and motion gates.
The split paths require 17 sampled textures per stage, or 19 for separate visibility; adapters with lower limits use the ordinary GI path.

workflow.screenTimingScope: Build through exploratory decision, excluding host wait and implementation/planning
workflow.note: The single nine-pair run also preserved its three-pair checkpoint. Full confirmation time includes build/tests, full replay, SSIM, manual review, host wait, all nine pairs and final saved-image analysis.

limitations: Sampled visual review and SSIM do not prove perceived quality across all scenes or frames.
CPU non-regression is not established: the paired interval still permits a meaningful regression. Report the observed CPU means and uncertainty separately from GPU gains.
The original ray oracle has nine BVH/CPU discrepancies out of 1000; candidate preserves all 2000 GPU ray answers exactly, including the 1000 passing terrain rays.
Results cover the fixed fpv-flight, 4K Ultra, RX 9070 XT, D3D12 configuration. Browser presentation latency and other hardware were not measured.

overnight.exploratoryMethod: One fixed native screen, then two existing original-baseline image/state checks only for promising candidates. No extra GPU quality flight, paired comparisons or broad tests per exploratory iteration. Full confirmation reserved for finalist.
overnight.elapsedSecondsScope: Automated immutable build through native screen and optional two-image evaluation; implementation/planning time is outside this value.

timingInstability.observation: Other project C++ build jobs became active. RAM had approximately 41 GiB free; no persistent heavy GPU user was observed after the run. CPU contention is a plausible cause, not proven attribution.
timingInstability.decision: Preserve all raw runs; do not use the slow control as a performance target. Require a stable fresh control before more GPU experiments.
